mapper.select: SELECT RELNAME AS ID, CAST ( OBJ_DESCRIPTION ( OID, 'pg_class' ) AS VARCHAR ) AS TABLENAME, 'TABLE' AS TABLETYPE FROM PG_CLASS C WHERE RELKIND = 'r' AND RELNAME NOT LIKE'pg_%' AND RELNAME NOT LIKE'sql_%' UNION ALL SELECT VIEWNAME AS ID, VIEWNAME AS TABLENAME, 'VIEW' AS TABLETYPE FROM PG_VIEWS WHERE SCHEMANAME ='public'

SELECT A.ATTNAME AS COLUMNNAME, D.DESCRIPTION AS ALIASNAME FROM PG_CLASS C, PG_ATTRIBUTE A , PG_TYPE T, PG_DESCRIPTION D WHERE C.RELNAME = #{tableName} AND A.ATTNUM>0 AND A.ATTRELID = C.OID AND A.ATTTYPID = T.OID AND D.OBJOID=A.ATTRELID AND D.OBJSUBID=A.ATTNUM ORDER BY C.RELNAME DESC,A.ATTNUM ASC;
